workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns localized scorecard blockers into a concrete repair design for later implementation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: repair design only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if blockers cannot be mapped to concrete metric or panel repairs
stop if repair design collapses role-specific surfaces back into global success ranking
stop if repair design requires profile-specific tuning
stop if next route is ambiguous
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if repair design cannot be made defensible
route to no-rollout repair materialization if design is complete
route to scenario/panel repair implementation only after the design separates metric-only and new-rollout changes
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1785 pivots from scorecard extraction to panel/metric repair

blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1786 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for no-rollout repair materialization or branch synthesis
